value.rationale: Conditional endpoint degrees are natural local tree statistics, and distance is a fundamental global geometry statistic. Exact joint dependence, a sharp terminal zero-covariance boundary, and simultaneous strict stochastic regression in a two-class host cannot be read from a one-vertex degree marginal. The result addresses the precise dependence left after fixing marked-vertex distance, rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
